CONFIRMED SOURCE GAP: task/environment/instructions/behaviour.md:15 requires 'Errors need the message and a one-based line number from the source I actually entered' and explicitly applies the same requirement to 'unhandled Promise rejections'. task/environment/instructions/security.md:5 supports ordinary source-written JavaScript and Promise callbacks without requiring rejection values to be Error objects. In task/solution/app/src/runtime.ts:82, fail(error, line = 0) defaults its line to zero; lines 88-90 read String(error?.stack || '') and use the default when no cw-user source stack exists. Line 93 calls fail(event.reason) for unhandledrejection without supplying a line. Line 200 renders a line only when data.line is truthy. Thus ordinary source Promise.reject('primitive-rejection') produces an error message without any source line. The shipped built frontend contains the same implementation at task/solution/app/public/assets/index-VduTT3aN.js:28681-28700 and 28958, so this is not a stale-source-only problem.

Independent executable source check: ran Node against the exact sandboxBootstrap function extracted read-only from runtime.ts, removing only the TypeScript 'as HTMLElement' assertion and providing minimal mocked browser event/document/timer bindings. Invoked its actual installed unhandledrejection handler in fresh contexts. An Error object whose source stack was cw-user-0-rejected-promise.js:2:1 emitted {kind:'error',message:'error-object-rejection',line:2,duration:0}; the primitive reason 'primitive-rejection' emitted {kind:'error',message:'primitive-rejection',line:0,duration:0}. This is an executable source-helper observation, not a browser run. A browser reproduction of this specific primitive case remains unexercised in the supplied logs.

Existing browser evidence does not refute the gap: qc/runs/coldwater-2026-09-30-hardening/golden/run-golden-20260930-070504/drivers/runtime_flow.cjs:100 uses Promise.reject(new Error('promise-error-marker')), and lines 101-104 check message, line 2 and rollback for that case. RESULTS.json facts.S13.promise_error_line.evidence.entered_source contains that same Error-object probe and expected_line 2; its console includes 'promise-error-marker · line 2'. This proves the Error-object case, not primitive reasons. Raw S19 records line-number gutter content, equal measured i/W text widths and multiple computed syntax colours for JS/HTML/CSS. Narrow-screen and complete keyboard navigation are supported plausibly by source here; this current RESULTS file does not independently demonstrate every such interaction. No visual-quality, full accessibility or full-judge result is inferred.

(7) security.md:3-11 requires isolated browser execution, guarded supported source, clear refusal of unsupported dynamic modes, harmless words remaining usable, no snippet external network, and saved source treated as text. runtime.ts:4 defines no-network CSP; lines 11-21 reject prohibited AST modes; lines 141-160 remove/limit active resources and use nonce scripts; PreviewRunner creates sandbox='allow-scripts' without allow-same-origin and validates source/token for incoming messages (173,184,191-200). public/runner.html:3-10 requires the parent's matching token and then writes only the prepared document. server.js performs SQL text storage and never evaluates snippet source. Raw S05 records four failed parent/storage attempts with app title/storage unchanged and successful recovery; S07 has a functioning transport control and no extra deliveries for fetch/image snippet attempts; S08 reports clear refusal of eval/Function/WebAssembly/workers/import and successful ordinary text containing those words.

(8) instruction.md:9 and integration.md:3-11 require source plus compiled frontend, supplied one-process Express/SQLite runtime, /app/server.js, 0.0.0.0:3000, /api/health, DB_PATH/default database, restart persistence without duplicate seeding and no /assets or /instructions dependency. solve.sh:4-7,26 copies the supplied complete app. server.js:2-8 uses only Node built-ins, Express and better-sqlite3 with DB_PATH; line 12 implements health; lines 100-102 serve local starters/public/index; lines 113-129 listen on 0.0.0.0 and create the SQLite schema idempotently. package.json:6-19 and vite.config.mjs include development build wiring; public/index.html references actual compiled JS/CSS. No package installation occurs at server start and no runtime fixture read is needed for the empty-library scope. Raw S22 and restart report a real helper call and PID change 16 to 335, same records after process restart and a successful new saved revision afterward.

The source and measured browser flows support the broad requested product. The one bounded missing deliverable is a source line for primitive unhandled Promise rejections.
